title: Customer escalation war room — Halo Therapeutics (prep + actions)
body:
Purpose / context:
- Prep notes for war-room with Halo Therapeutics (reporting production regression in hosted inference since 2026-03-19 21:30 UTC).
- Goal for first sync: stabilize customer traffic (failover to fallback model / rate-limiting), gather data to root-cause, and agree on short-term mitigation + timeline to fix.

Attendees (invite list):
- Jordan Kim (owner, CS)
body_continued:
- Sana Patel (support lead)
- Marco Alvarez (serving-runtime eng)
- Priya Desai (SRE)
- Alex Chen (Customer success AM)
- Halo oncall: Dr. Meera Rao (primary), backup: Tom Evans

Agenda (30–45m):
1) Quick customer summary + severity (5m)
   - Impact: elevated tail latency, ~8% 5xxs, customers seeing 2x inference latency for long-context requests.
   - Traffic: 12% of requests are to long-context model variant (seq_len > 4096).
2) What we know (10m)
   - Incident start: 2026-03-19 21:30 UTC (spike in model OOM / kernel timeouts)
   - Recent deploy? A small runtime kernel tweak was merged 2026-03-18 (PR #4021).
   - Related tickets: INF-2345 (kernel patch), CS-8742 (customer report).
3) Immediate mitigations (10m)
   - Route Halo traffic to fallback model variant (v1.3-quant) using smart routing policy (contact Marco to trigger).
   - Apply temporary rate-limiter on long-context route: 20 rps burst, 5 rps sustained.
   - Increase autoscale headroom on Dedicated pool (if Halo on Dedicated) or spin up extra workers in hosted region eu-west-1.
4) Data collection + triage tasks (10m)
   - Logs to gather: kernel timeouts (last 72h), GPU OOM logs, model trace for seq_len distribution.
   - Perf traces: enable P99 tracing for next 2h.
5) Communication plan + next check-in (5m)
   - Confirm customer-facing message (Alex to send status email at T+30m).
   - Next sync: 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC (30m) or sooner if rollback completes.

Immediate action items (owner — due):
- Marco Alvarez — route Halo to fallback variant + confirm routing change succeeds (by 2026-03-22 13:15 UTC).
- Priya Desai — check autoscaler logs and provision extra workers if required; report capacity delta (by 2026-03-22 13:30 UTC).
- Sana Patel — collect kernel timeout stack traces and attach to INF-2345 (by 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC).
- Alex Chen — draft and send customer status update (short, transparent, next steps) and post to Slack thread (by 2026-03-22 13:45 UTC).
- Jordan Kim — owner/liaison; escalate to Eng Pager if route rollback fails and coordinate Playstation (by 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC).

Playbook / rollback plan (quick notes):
- If fallback routing does not reduce 5xxs within 15m, rollback PR #4021 from 2026-03-18 (INF-2345) and trigger rolling restart of affected nodes (Priya + Marco).
- Ensure cache invalidation for KV caches post-rollout to avoid inconsistent generations.

Notes to self / open questions:
- Do we have telemetry on model kernel selection failures vs. pure OOM? (Marco)
- Confirm whether Halo is on Dedicated or hosted (Alex to confirm).
- Check whether the customer has any regulatory constraints preventing fallback to quantized variant.

Customer-facing lines (short, to be reviewed by legal):
- "We are aware of elevated errors and increased latency for some long-context requests. Our team has taken a mitigation to route traffic to a stable variant and is actively investigating the root cause. We will share an update within the hour and follow up with a post-incident summary."

Post-meeting follow-up template (to copy into JIRA / Confluence):
- Summary of actions taken
- Timeline of events
- Logs/artifacts collected (links)
- Owners and next steps + ETA

Quick checklist to run during war-room:
- [ ] Confirm Zoom recording + invite + Slack channel pinned
- [ ] Mark CS-8742 as "in-work" and link INF-2345
- [ ] Snapshot current autoscaler group sizes
- [ ] Validate fallback model outputs on a small sample of requests (Sana)

Draft minutes will be copied into CS ticket and Confluence page post-sync.

-- Jordan (notes)
